I wrote `component.html` in the folder, with the whole screen inside `#component` at 1280px. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Contents:** The top navigation has "Overview" as the current page, then "Requests", "Team" and "Settings". Below it are the "Overview" heading, the four stat tiles and the five-item "Recent activity" list, all with your exact wording.
- **Rules followed:** I applied the `DESIGN.md` rules for the page and navigation, the tiles and the list. Colours, sizes, spacing and letter-spacing all use the `tokens.css` values, which I copied into the file's `<style>` so it stands alone.
- **No primary button:** `DESIGN.md` wants one primary action at the right of the title row. You said to use exactly your content, so I left it out.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder. The file uses the token font stacks, which fall back to `system-ui`, so the type will look different from the real site.
- **Activity card padding:** The list card has no top or bottom padding, so the dividers sit between rows instead of leaving a 24px gap above the first row and below the last.
